message.essentialcraft5.hoanna_event.ley.en: The ley lines are surging. Shards of crystal are falling from the sky.
message.essentialcraft5.hoanna_event.ley.zh: 地脉在翻涌，天上开始往下落晶体了。

message.essentialcraft5.hoanna_event.ley.en: The ley lines have calmed down.

hud.essentialcraft5.hoanna_event.ley_sto.en: Open sky adds radiation. Walk into falling crystals to pick them up.
hud.essentialcraft5.hoanna_event.ley_sto.zh: 露天会加辐射。落下的晶体走过去碰一下就收了。

commands.essentialcraft5.hoanna_event.st.en: Started %s in Hoanna for %s (a ley storm only lasts until dawn)
commands.essentialcraft5.hoanna_event.st.zh: 海纳尔开始了%s，持续 %s（地脉风暴到黎明为止）
